issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as double, but the reference solution declares these attributes as int. This mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about which types to implement (the task explicitly asks to follow the UML order and types) and may lead to inconsistencies in method implementations that depend on these fields.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent. Either update the problem statement/UML to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int (recommended, to match the solution and the integer return types used in methods), or update the solution and template to use double for these attributes and adjust related methods (getTotalNumberOfStudents, getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor, getters/setters) accordingly so all artifacts agree.
